title: The Earth goes on

shots.name: A place inside the rock
shots.intent: Continue the exact jewel hold, then make a deliberate change of scale.

shots.name: The land folds
shots.intent: The painted strata carry the tiny housing while the land deforms.

shots.name: Ice crosses the land
shots.intent: A glacier advances through a recognizable valley.

shots.name: Below the surface
shots.intent: Camera descends from painted terrain into fired and mineral matter.

shots.name: Time without landmarks
shots.intent: Hold in the warm, abstract deep interior; elapsed time is unspecified.

shots.name: A later Earth
shots.intent: Rise into a later frozen surface, after an unmeasured interval.

shots.name: The green returns
shots.intent: Ice recedes, then vegetation occupies the valley.

shots.name: An uninhabited clearing
shots.intent: Ordinary time resumes in a living forest, without visible animals.

shots.name: Arrival
shots.intent: An exploratory craft settles into the clearing.

shots.name: Looking
shots.intent: Two visitors emerge and inspect the apparently empty surroundings.

shots.name: The question
shots.intent: An alien question repeats the child's words in an exact English subtitle.

shots.name: Departure
shots.intent: The visitors return to their craft and leave without discovering the polis.

constraints: B is the primary geological material; C with A supplies the deep interior.
No dates or literal external-to-polis clock ratio.
The jewel remains buried; camera travel does not carry it into the core.
Only the two visitors are visible animal-like figures in the forest.
Human recurrence, jewel retrieval, feast and ending are outside this segment.
The film's final quarter-second silence does not belong at this boundary.
